head: Post Club is a little typewriter for writing notes and letters
dek: Post Club lets you pick a typewriter, feed in paper and type a birthday wish, a thank-you or a hello with clicking keys, then pull the page out to send it. It was #14 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
details: It came out on 3 November and costs $4.99 with in-app purchases, by Larry Le Chen.
means: If you like sending personal notes, it turns them into small typed letters.
todo: Find Post Club in the App Store; check the in-app purchases.
